boundaries.name: hash-security-and-canonical-field
boundaries.obligation: Poseidon compression soundness, canonical field outputs and concrete compared-input collision binding are not proved here; encoded tuple injectivity is not hash injectivity.

boundaries.name: imported-gate-lowering
boundaries.obligation: Derive SplitGates from actual Goldilocks split_low_high/is_equal/mul/assert_zero gates and compiler; local modular arithmetic uniqueness alone is not this lowering proof.

boundaries.name: native-and-target-representation
boundaries.obligation: Rust fixed-width/cast/vector behavior and emitted targets require source refinement; the model retains u32 casts and raw-native vs modular-target distinctions.

boundaries.name: caller-authentication-and-fund-ownership
boundaries.obligation: The helper accepts a header root and full rows, does not authenticate a channel, verify a signature/opening, validate counts/registry/suffixes, decrypt balances or prove resource custody.
